description: Signed-in only. Side effect: adds new cards to a study set the person owns on SpeakBase; every practice mode and the spoken lesson with Kate then include them. It only adds: existing cards, their review history and the set's other settings are not changed or deleted, and a term already in the set is skipped. Stops at the account's card limit per set (free student 30, free teacher 60, Premium 500).

cards.description: The new cards. term is the word or phrase in the set's language; definition is its meaning.

set_id.description: The set_id that create_set returned, or the set's SpeakBase link.

name: add_cards
title: Add cards to my set
